title: French Beef Bisque
description: A hearty and comforting French-inspired beef soup made with tender beef, rich vegetables, and a touch of cognac. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, cognac (if using), tomato paste, and flour to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
If desired, stir in the heavy cream to add a rich and creamy texture.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
